name: How does a two-story addition affect my existing home's structure?

mainEntity.name: How does a two-story addition affect my existing home's structure?

acceptedAnswer.text: A two-story addition significantly impacts your existing home's structure, requiring careful engineering to ensure the foundation and load-bearing walls can support the added weight. Structural modifications are often necessary to maintain integrity and safety. Our process includes a thorough structural assessment by qualified engineers to determine the best approach for integrating the new structure with your current home.
acceptedAnswer.description: A two-story addition requires careful engineering to ensure the existing foundation and load-bearing walls can support the new weight, often necessitating structural modifications.
